{"consolidated_memory":"INFINITE RECURSION IN GRAPH/TRAVERSAL/WALKER.RS — 6 DISTINCT INCIDENTS (2026-04-22 to 2026-07-26)

Component: graph/traversal/walker.rs (Rust, graph engine side). Reproducible trigger for all: walk the cyclic fixture graph. Common signal: stack grows until guard trips.

OCCASION 1 [2026-04-22]:
- Trigger: traffic arriving through corporate proxy
- Root cause: clock skew between two hosts
- Fix: switched deadline to monotonic clock (PR #1478, branch fix/infinite-recursion-1)
- Result: memory settled at 99 MB instead of climbing past 9 GB

OCCASION 2 [2026-05-19]:
- Trigger: after rolling restart of fleet
- Root cause: schema drift between migration and model
- Fix: regenerated model from migration and pinned checksum (PR #3878, branch fix/infinite-recursion-2)
- Result: throughput rose 97 percent to 109 requests per second

OCCASION 3 [2026-05-25]:
- Trigger: after client had already retried once
- Root cause: off-by-one in slice bound
- Fix: corrected bound and added property test (PR #6082, branch fix/infinite-recursion-3)
- Result: alert stayed quiet for 82 consecutive days

OCCASION 4 [2026-05-30]:
- Trigger: tenants with more than ten thousand distinct keys
- Root cause: serialiser dropping fields it did not know
- Fix: switched to strict schema rejecting unknown fields (PR #8488, branch fix/infinite-recursion-4)
- Result: nightly rollup matched source counts for 73 days running

OCCASION 5 [2026-06-15]:
- Trigger: accounts in five percent rollout bucket
- Root cause: config loader reading wrong environment file
- Fix: made environment selection explicit and failed closed on ambiguity (PR #8612, branch fix/infinite-recursion-5)
- Result: cold start dropped 75 percent to 356 ms
- Testing: covered by module test block in graph/traversal/walker.rs

OCCASION 6 [2026-07-26]:
- Trigger: sessions arriving through OAuth provider
- Root cause: error swallowed by bare except handler
- Fix: narrowed handler and let failure propagate (PR #8673, branch fix/infinite-recursion-6)
- Result: p99 latency fell from 6.6 s to 55 ms

All six incidents involved the same corner of walker.rs; context from earlier work carried over to each fix."}
